QuestInfo.name: Protect the Girl
QuestInfo.0: Lania needs to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Ask Vieren about keeping Lania safe.
QuestInfo.2: Vieren had a few ideas for keeping Lania safe.

0.0: Are you sure you can't stay?\r\n#L0##bI wish I could. But fear not! I shall be watching over you. And I will visit you again soon.#l\n#k
0.1: You'd better! It's too empty here without you to keep me company.\r\n#L0##bI'll return as soon as I know how to keep you safe. I'll be as quick as I can! (Vieren might have some ideas.)#l\n#k
0.2: I'm okay, really. But if you insist...

no.0: Did you change your mind? It's safe after all, right?

1.0: Well? Was she happy to see you?\r\n#L0##bI believe so... I hope. More importantly, I encountered the Black Mage's minions in the forest near her home.#l\n#k
1.1: Drats! If they're up and about already, the big guy himself won't be far behind.\r\n#L0##bI must track down the Black Mage, but first we have to see to Lania's safety. If the Black Mage realizes that I care for her...#l\n#k
1.2: Right, right. Well, I've got a few ideas...
